{{Conjecture|legends}}
The only major settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[D'vouran]] was a small '''spaceport.''' The [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was devoid of cargo, [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and workers and instead resembled a deserted junk heap. Surrounding the spaceport was a primitive village built by the [[Enzeen]] for outside visitors. It's houses were simple one-story structures made of mud and its dirt streets lacked vehicles. A [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] named the [[Don't Go Inn]] was located in the settlement. [[Smada]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] built a [[Smada's stronghold|fortress]] just beyond the outskirts of the city. The spaceport and surrounding village was constructed to accommodate [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] that crashed on the planet and settlers who were drawn to the world because of its climate, resources, seclusion, and hospitality. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the settlement boasted a population of a few hundred. While the Enzeen appeared to serve as the settler's servants and guides, they were actually attracting more settlers to their world to feed the living planet. [[0 ABY/Legends|Shortly after]] the Battle of Yavin, all the settlers in the village were eaten by D'vouran and the spaceport was destroyed when the planet devoured itself.
